correctness.rationale: Complete direct proof for arbitrary fields and positive dimensions: Q squaring shifts supports; Q^n(v0)=v0 forces invariance by n; support disjointness yields gcd(m,n)=n and one residue class; coefficients follow the unique 2^n-power recurrence and close exactly when c^(2^m-1)=1; converse preserves all products and gives rank n. Free precomposition by Aut(C_n) counts images, and rotations plus diagonal roots give one target orbit. All cases including n=1, finite char 2, n=m and impossible dimensions are covered. Standalone verify.py passed 17 exhaustive small-field linear-map sets and five independent subspace censuses. No finite case is invoked as proof of an infinite assertion.

value.rationale: The problem is a complete natural Hom-set and embedded-subalgebra classification for an unbounded two-parameter family of perfect strongly-connected nonassociative algebras, precisely where ordinary subalgebras differ from extendable-natural-basis subalgebras. It yields a reversed graph-cycle divisibility obstruction, exact arithmetic counts, and a transitive automorphism action with uniform orbit sizes, not a small arbitrary parameter slice. Roots-of-unity arithmetic determines a precise natural invariant for every finite field. Nontrivial strict case 2<=n<m is not supplied by known same-dimension automorphism or one-dimensional idempotent counts; no claim is made for general weighted algebras.
